2390-6191-8173.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6191-8173.description:
Gain life.
Lyra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Angel you control
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

333-6798-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-6798-8207.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2366-3899-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
"[Type]" chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
2366-3899-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7322.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

215-850-1879.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-1879.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-1129-5223.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-5223.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

5147-7084-7705.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

5641-6720-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6720-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-4772-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-6594-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6594-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2558-3490-5231-5315-6701.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-5231-5315-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

2558-4659-4742-5687.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Nahiri's Resolve, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Repeat.

957-2061-3277.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Stretch each other turn.
957-2061-3277.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

3143-3197-4613-4762.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3143-3197-4613-4762.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Xavier Sal using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

717-4050-4067-5458.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
An opponent controls a targetable artifact, land or creature.
717-4050-4067-5458.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, targeting an artifact, land or creature an opponent controls.
Marchesa and Bone Miser trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, either adding {B}{B}, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token, or causing you to draw a card.
If you created a Zombie token and your mana pool is empty, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {1}.
If you drew a card and your mana pool is empty, activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, targeting any permanent you control, triggering Bone Miser.
Repeat from step 3 until you have resolved all Bone Miser triggers and have at least {1} available.
Resolve the Marchesa trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to look at the top two cards of your library and put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
Repeat.

215-1418-1789-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
215-1418-1789-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing another artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Lathliss trigger twice.
Resolve both Realm-Scorcher Hellkite triggers, adding {5}{R}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Lathliss triggers, creating two 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

276-2773-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-1778-4050-5222.description:
Cast Memnite.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Memnite for {0}.
Sacrifice Memnite to Phyrexian Altar to add a mana of any color.
Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Memnite to your hand.
Repeat.

1112-2050-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Weirding Wood attached to a Forest you control.
1112-2050-3525.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by Weirding Wood, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.
